[email protected] Cybersecurity Analyst An IT services company is seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst to monitor and protect client systems across on-premises and cloud environments. The role focuses on assessing security risks, coordinating remediation and verifying that corrective actions are effective. It also supports the company’s internal data protection programme. Key Responsibilities Conduct routine vulnerability scans and security assessments across client workstations, servers, network devices, applications and cloud environments. Review scan results, confirm findings and prioritise remediation based on severity, exposure and potential business impact. Assess security configurations, user permissions and authentication controls. Recommend changes to address configuration weaknesses and excessive access. Coordinate remediation with client contacts, internal technical teams and third-party vendors. Document corrective actions, agree on timelines and escalate high-risk or overdue findings. Apply security patches to Windows workstations, servers, switches and firewalls. Coordinate configuration changes and other corrective measures where required. Rescan affected systems and review configurations to verify that fixes are effective. Document outstanding risks and recommend interim controls where immediate remediation is impractical. Coordinate third-party vulnerability assessments and penetration tests, review findings and track agreed corrective actions through to closure. Monitor security alerts and logs across Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, firewalls, intrusion detection systems and endpoint protection tools. Investigate suspected security breaches, assist with containment and recovery, and recommend measures to reduce the likelihood of recurrence. Prepare monthly security summaries and quarterly vulnerability reports covering significant findings, remediation progress and outstanding risks. Deliver security awareness training and support internal compliance with Jamaica’s Data Protection Act, 2020. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Networking, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent qualification. At least two years of relevant experience. Strong hands-on experience securing cloud environments , including monitoring security alerts, assessing configurations and access controls, and remediating vulnerabilities. Cybersecurity or network security certification, such as CompTIA Security+ or CySA+. Proficiency with Microsoft tools and experience monitoring on-premises systems. Strong analytical, report-writing and customer service skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and work independently. Email your resume by December 15, 2026 .
